topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: It’s as if the invention, which floated in my mind like a gentle cloud, has already found its home in the sky of someone else’s thoughts. It’s a surprise, to be sure, but I find myself marveling at how vast the world is, how many brilliant minds are reaching for the same stars. Perhaps this means my idea is a true reflection of what the world needs, what it’s yearning for. I’ll take a step back, admire the symmetry of our spirits aligning, and let it guide me to a new horizon where my cloud can take a new, uncharted shape. After all, the sky has room for more than one dream.
